overview: The board approved a special permit for the city's first accessory dwelling unit and authorized a revised site plan for the Saltonstall modernization project to relocate required parking. They also approved a site plan for new Tufts University tennis courts and a land swap plan to facilitate the extension of the Wellington Greenway.

items.title: 11 Paul Road Accessory Dwelling Unit
items.summary: Approved a special permit for the city’s first accessory dwelling unit, converting an existing garage into a 484-square-foot residential space.

items.title: Saltonstall Modernization Site Plan Revision
items.summary: Approved a modified site plan for 121 Riverside Avenue to provide 111 required parking spaces entirely on housing authority property because a planned lease of state-owned land could not be finalized before financing closed.

items.title: Tufts University Tennis Courts Site Plan Review
items.summary: Approved a site plan for eight new tennis courts, LED sports lighting, and bleachers at 161 College Avenue, including a subsurface stormwater storage system to mitigate neighborhood flooding.

items.title: Wellington Greenway Land Swap ANR Plan
items.summary: Approved an Approval Not Required plan to codify a land swap between the MBTA and the Department of Conservation and Recreation, enabling the extension of the Wellington Greenway path.

items.title: Minutes and Administrative Updates
items.summary: Approved the January 4, 2023 minutes and discussed new procedures for reviewing Zoning Board of Appeals special permits for advisory opinions.
